scripts.clean: cd android && ./gradlew clean && cd ../ios && rm -rf build
scripts.clean:all: rm -rf node_modules && npm install && cd android && ./gradlew clean && cd ../ios && rm -rf build && cd .. && npx react-native start --reset-cache
scripts.android:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=Development PLATFORM=android npm run prebuild && react-native run-android --mode=developmentDebug --appIdSuffix development
scripts.android:production: cross-env NODE_ENV=Production PLATFORM=android npm run prebuild && react-native run-android --mode=productionRelease
scripts.android:productionApk: cross-env NODE_ENV=Production PLATFORM=android npm run prebuild && cd android && ./gradlew clean && ./gradlew assembleProductionRelease
scripts.android:productionAab: cross-env NODE_ENV=Production PLATFORM=android npm run prebuild && cd android && ./gradlew clean && ./gradlew bundleProductionRelease
scripts.android:staging: cross-env NODE_ENV=Staging PLATFORM=android npm run prebuild && react-native run-android --mode=stagingDebug --appIdSuffix staging
scripts.android:stagingApk: cross-env NODE_ENV=Staging PLATFORM=android npm run prebuild && cd android && ./gradlew clean && ./gradlew assembleStagingRelease
scripts.ios:production: cross-env NODE_ENV=Production PLATFORM=ios npm run prebuild && react-native run-ios --mode Debug
scripts.ios:productionAdHocIpa: cross-env NODE_ENV=Production PLATFORM=ios npm run prebuild && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace qciapplicantapp.xcworkspace -scheme qciapplicantapp -configuration Release -archivePath ./build/qciapplicantapp.xcarchive archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath ./build/qciapplicantapp.xcarchive -exportPath ./build/ipa -exportOptionsPlist ./AdHocExportOptions.plist -allowProvisioningUpdates
scripts.ios:productionAppStoreIpa: cross-env NODE_ENV=Production PLATFORM=ios npm run prebuild && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace qciapplicantapp.xcworkspace -scheme qciapplicantapp -configuration Release -archivePath ./build/qciapplicantapp.xcarchive archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath ./build/qciapplicantapp.xcarchive -exportPath ./build/ipa -exportOptionsPlist ./AppStoreExportOptions.plist -allowProvisioningUpdates
